name: Daniel Lawrence Braine
bioAdditions: Line in Lawrence 1858 (S1): Deborah Smith & William Lawrence Jr. -> Daniel (d. 1757, m. Mary Redwood) -> Abraham (m. Mary Smith) -> Elizabeth (m. Capt. Daniel H. Braine) -> Abraham L. Braine (b. 1782, m. 1811 Agnes Dean Hamilton) -> Daniel Lawrence Braine, 'now lieutenant in the United States Navy', married 1855 Mary E. Fulton: 5th cousin 6 times removed.
